title: 대수기하학 원론 (EGA) — 한국어 누적판 / Éléments de géométrie algébrique — Korean Cumulative Edition
description:
This cumulative Korean edition contains complete EGA 0_I, EGA I, and EGA II. The EGA II portion includes the Chapter II front matter and programme, the complete main text through Section 8 and Proposition 8.14.14 with its proof, the bibliography, notation and terminology indexes, original contents, and errata and addenda, each through the end of its canonical source file. The wider EGA corpus remains incomplete; this release makes no claim that later EGA volumes have been translated.

The pertinent human-readable preview is 00_EGA_ko_CUMULATIVE_READER.pdf, presented first in the file order. It is a 437-page A4 PDF of 2,552,588 bytes with SHA-256 7F9B246E2623FB1992903C76A2AE2E46A7AD9FCC7B1FC7804DF4E0E2ADFBD575. The reader preserves 423 historical source-page markers across the included EGA material while adding edition front matter and navigation for the cumulative Korean reader.

The deterministic editable-source archive contains the integrated Korean TeX sources, cumulative source-coverage matrix, build driver, license, citation metadata, public description, and packaging script. The coverage matrix binds every completed Korean target to its canonical source identity, exact source extent, target identity, order, and historical-page count. The archive is 452,998 bytes with SHA-256 431C079BCAEA823A9979ABB0B19125C5E726E72FF26A94270695E4DD35882140.

The evidence and provenance archive is deliberately bounded. It contains the terminal build receipt, the terminal receipt for the single complete-reader aggregate PDF check, the exact cumulative source matrix, the license, 13 contact sheets, and the two full-resolution pages used to resolve the sparse-page heuristic. It excludes the transient full-resolution page-render set because the retained contact sheets and disposition pages provide the pertinent compact visual record. The archive is 23,142,101 bytes with SHA-256 AFB44BB139306B17C9963581680469713EEDAD1C40F565C19F0118C1D2595B05.

The reader was produced by one mutex-serialized four-pass XeLaTeX convergence build. Passes 3 and 4 were byte-identical, and the promoted reader is byte-identical to the converged output. Exactly one aggregate check of the complete 437-page reader followed. It used no per-section check loops and no repeated whole-reader run. The sparse-page finding was resolved from the already generated images: physical page 13 is an intentional sparse chapter opening, and physical page 427 is the declared historical blank carrying its preserved page marker. No source or reader byte changed, and the aggregate check was not repeated.

The release package only copied and hashed the already validated bytes. Its deterministic archives use fixed entry metadata and each archive received one post-write entry-name, size, content, and hash readback. The accompanying SHA-256 manifest records the three principal artifact identities.

The stable Korean EGA concept DOI is 10.5281/zenodo.21921513. The public source repository is github.com/KokunoYumeto/ega-ko.

Alexander Grothendieck and Jean Dieudonné are the historical creators of the mathematical work. AI typesetting & translation is the sole standardized project contributor. This independently maintained Korean edition is not endorsed by the historical authors, NUMDAM, IHÉS, publishers, repositories, or cited third parties.

CC BY 4.0 applies only where the project holds the relevant rights: the Korean translation and typesetting, together with project-authored metadata, indexes, decisions, and verification evidence. The underlying mathematical work, historical French edition, bibliography, and all other third-party material retain their exact provenance, attribution, author/source relationships, rights, and licence status. Editable TeX and rendered formulae remain authoritative where legacy mathematics-font text extraction is lossy.
